text.p: A stake of 4.25 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Wednesday at an average 2,870.06 roubles ($0.527) a share, down from 3,015.78 roubles at the previous auction on October 21, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Only 4.25 million shares or 17 lots out of the 10 million shares or 40 lots on offer were sold.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 214 million shares, equivalent to 0.9 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6. Usually the average price is higher than at the preceding auction and all shares are sold.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.440 at 1345 GMT on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, up from $0.420 on Tuesday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $17.45 after $17.13. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next auction will be held on November 5, when 10 million shares in 40 lots will be offered at a starting price of 2,153 roubles a share.
